title: Port fixed-selection total-least-squares plane fitting
scope: Complete fitPlaneTLS and planeResidual, with minimal private centroidOf/symmetricEigen3/normalizeOrZ dependencies. No clipping/RANSAC/two-plane split or general eigensolver API claim.
acceptance: Independent original/native/browser-Wasm presence, plane fields and every selected residual under the pre-registered fixed comparison contract.
Retain Jacobi sweeps/pairs/order, covariance accumulation, eigenvector direction and source refusals.
open_items: Browser-Wasm runtime, general eigensolver coverage, extreme/nonfinite/near-collinear corpus and broader normal orientations remain open.
G0/P05 and general P36 exact-base ratchet remain incomplete.
Clipping, robust starts, splitting, selection growth and engine/session integration are missing continuations tracked by parent P07.
The compensated norm is the explicit Math.hypot portability boundary; further platforms must satisfy the frozen tolerance without relaxation.
